newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's GMA Network 9-mth net up 48 percent.
newsitem.headline: Manila's GMA Network 9-mth net up 48 percent.

text.p: Broadcaster GMA Network Inc said on Tuesday its after-tax profit surged by 48 percent to 216 million pesos in the first nine months compared with 145 million pesos in the year-ago period.
Net sales for the period rose by 12 percent to 1.347 billion pesos from 1.207 billion pesos.

The firm said it had set aside 1.5 billion pesos for capital expenditures, which would include new headquarters that will house state-of-the-art equipment. Construction of the new building will start in December this year.
GMA is the main rival of ABS-CBN Broadcasting Corp, the country's leading television company.
GMA has said it is planning an initial public offering.
